column1: # Errors an immutable record can no longer be spared.
# A tracked inventory may never be edited, recalculated or reused, so a defect
# written into one cannot be repaired by a later commit. Listing it here keeps
# the contract gateable without pretending the defect is not there: the errors
# are still reported, with the reason below.
# The reason starts with the defect class and a colon; the entry excuses only
# the errors that class produces (ERRATUM_CLASSES in documentation_contract.py),
# so a new, different error in the same inventory still fails.
# Only `docs/inventories/` paths may appear, and only while they really fail —
# a stale entry is itself an error, so this list can only shrink.

column2: unbounded-pathspec: its seven boundaries were written on one line, so none matches a row; the delivered bytes are correct and fully listed, and the inventory is immutable
